research.title: Image Preprocessing for Surface Defect Recognition
bullets: Implemented assigned image normalization and patch extraction routines in Python for a surface defect recognition pipeline, following provided preprocessing specifications.
Checked extracted patches against image annotations and summarized classification errors by defect category using the group's existing evaluation procedure.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory records, reconciled delivery paperwork with received goods, and flagged discrepancies for review by the responsible operations staff.
Coordinated routine order processing, updated shipment status logs, and organized supporting documents for customer inquiries and internal handoffs.

projects.title: Handcrafted Feature Baseline for Image Classification
bullets: Implemented a baseline image classifier using NumPy color histograms and a scikit-learn support vector machine with standardized input features.
Evaluated predictions on a held-out split, inspected confusion matrices, and compared classification errors across images with different lighting conditions.
